instruction.name: vslti.bu
instruction.description: Compare the unsigned 8-bit elements in `a` and the zero-extended `imm`, store all-ones to `dst` if corresponding element in `a` is less than `imm`, zero otherwise.

latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 20000, iters 500. Raw measurement was 1.00; the residual is a systematic calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: vslti.bu $vr0, $vr8, 1; vslti.bu $vr1, $vr9, 1; vslti.bu $vr2, $vr10, 1; vslti.bu $vr3, $vr11, 1; vslti.bu $vr4, $vr12, 1; vslti.bu $vr5, $vr13, 1; vslti.bu $vr6, $vr14, 1; vslti.bu $vr7, $vr15, 1
throughput.init: li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr15, $r4
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 5 --core 0 --init 'li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr15, $r4' --asm 'vslti.bu $vr0, $vr8, 1; vslti.bu $vr1, $vr9, 1; vslti.bu $vr2, $vr10, 1; vslti.bu $vr3, $vr11, 1; vslti.bu $vr4, $vr12, 1; vslti.bu $vr5, $vr13, 1; vslti.bu $vr6, $vr14, 1; vslti.bu $vr7, $vr15, 1'

notes: Latency values are reported as whole cycles; earlier two-decimal values and +/-0.1 bands were rounding artifacts of the measurement pipeline.
